title: Four stages
stem: Which of these animals has a 4-stage life cycle?
key: 4 stages (egg, larva, pupa, adult): butterfly, beetle, mosquito.

options.pick: Cockroaches are insects, like butterflies.
options.why: A cockroach has 3 stages: egg, nymph, adult. There is no pupa.

options.pick: Chickens hatch from eggs and change a lot.
options.why: A chicken has 3 stages: egg, chick, adult.

options.pick: Which animal has a pupa?
options.why: A butterfly has 4 stages: egg, larva (caterpillar), pupa, adult.

options.pick: It is an insect that changes as it grows.
options.why: A grasshopper has 3 stages: egg, nymph, adult.

title: A mosquito's stages
stem: Which shows the stages of a mosquito's life cycle in order?
key: A 4-stage cycle goes egg → larva → pupa → adult.

options.pick: The two middle stages are easy to swap.
options.why: The larva comes before the pupa.

options.pick: Many small insects have a nymph stage.
options.why: A mosquito has 4 stages, with a larva and a pupa.

options.pick: The larva is the stage people notice first.
options.why: Every cycle here starts with the egg.

options.pick: Recall the 4-stage order.
options.why: A mosquito goes from egg to larva to pupa to adult.

title: A pupa
stem: Which statement describes a pupa?
key: A pupa does not feed or move. The adult forms inside it.

options.text: It does not feed or move, and the adult forms inside it.
options.pick: Which stage is still?
options.why: The pupa is a resting stage. The adult forms inside.

options.text: It eats a lot and grows quickly.
options.pick: Young insects seem to eat a lot.
options.why: That describes a larva.

options.text: It looks like a small adult without wings.
options.pick: It comes just before the adult.
options.why: That describes a nymph.

options.pick: It is the last stage before the cycle repeats.
options.why: The adult lays the eggs.

title: A plant's stages

title: Why it is a cycle
stem: Why do we call it a life cycle?
key: The adult reproduces (eggs or seeds), so the stages start again.

options.text: Because it ends when the adult dies
options.pick: Life seems to end at the adult.
options.why: Before that, the adult lays eggs or makes seeds, which start the stages again.

options.text: Because the adult lays eggs or makes seeds, so the stages start again
options.pick: What does the adult do that starts the next round?
options.why: The adult reproduces, so the same stages repeat.

options.text: Because the adult turns back into an egg
options.pick: The cycle seems to go back to the start.
options.why: The adult doesn't change back. It produces new eggs.

options.text: Because every living thing goes through exactly the same stages
options.pick: "Cycle" seems to mean the same for all.
options.why: Different living things have different stages.

stem:
A tadpole lives in water and has a tail.

What will it become?
